blocks.title: Commercial Engine
blocks.body: Conrad Hotels & Resorts commercial distribution rides Hilton Honors direct channels, GDS, OTAs, and parent sales systems. Contemporary luxury: modern design, elevated service, and Hilton Honors distribution for travelers seeking polished luxury without Waldorf heritage cues. Owners should underwrite channel mix and loyalty contribution for this asset—not corporate averages alone.

blocks.title: Hilton Honors
blocks.body: Conrad Hotels & Resorts participates in Hilton Honors. Members earn and redeem points and receive Elite recognition across participating sister brands. Confirm current tier names and earn rules on the official program site before IC.

blocks.title: Earn
blocks.body: Guests earn Hilton Honors points on qualifying stays at Conrad Hotels & Resorts. Elite members may receive enhanced earn and recognition benefits per current program rules.

blocks.title: Redeem
blocks.body: Points redeem for stays across the Hilton Honors portfolio, including Conrad Hotels & Resorts, subject to availability and current redemption charts.

blocks.title: Elite Recognition
blocks.body: Elite status recognition (upgrades, late checkout, lounge access where offered) applies per property capability—delivery varies by hotel.

blocks.title: Ecosystem

blocks.title: Owner Lens

blocks.title: Repeat Guest Capture

blocks.title: Why Value Is Strongest in These Scenarios
blocks.body:
Keep Local Product Intent—Add Hilton Honors: retain Conrad Hotels & Resorts's brand promise while accessing loyalty earn/redeem and parent commercial systems a standalone hotel cannot buy alone.
Contemporary luxury: modern design, elevated service, and Hilton Honors distribution for travelers seeking polished luxury without Waldorf heritage cues.
Sibling Clarity: diligence fit versus same-parent peers before assuming identical owner use case or fee path.
Operator & Owner Fit: strongest when the asset can deliver the brand's guest promise with QA discipline—weakest when sponsors want the flag without the product investment.
Disclosure Discipline: model economics only from current fee exhibits—Factory 2.0 does not invent undisclosed percentages.
